speaker: NARRATOR
text: [excited, hushed] What if your parents... joined your Roblox server?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] Your mom is number one on the leaderboard.

speaker: MOM
text: [sweetly] Good game, sweetie! [pause] Drink some water!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] Your granny owns half the server. [pause] Your friends work for her now.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [sweet, firm] Faster, boys! Those cookies won't sell themselves!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] And your dad... has been walking into the same wall for three hours.

speaker: DAD
text: [shouting at the screen] JUMP! [pause] Computer, I said JUMP!

speaker: YOU
text: [panicked] This is MY server! How did this even HAPPEN?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] Well. [pause] It all started with a family breakfast.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [storyteller] This is you. In real life, you're just a kid. [pause] But in Cube City... you're a legend.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Level ninety-nine. The best base in Tycoon Valley. Two thousand wins in the arena.

speaker: YOU
text: [proud] Two thousand and ONE.

speaker: YOU
text: [showing off] Welcome to my castle. [pause] Lava pool. Trophy room. [pause] And this... is my throne.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] The throne was just a chair. [pause] A very expensive chair.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: That's Noodle. Your best friend. You've never met in real life... [pause] but you've beaten four hundred bosses together.

speaker: NOODLE
text: [excited] Bro! Bro, bro, bro! New update! [pause] The Block King is coming!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And that's DarkBlade. Nobody knows who he really is. [pause] Nobody knows why he's always so angry.

speaker: DARKBLADE
text: [edgy, slow] You got lucky last time, YOU. [pause] Enjoy your little castle.

speaker: YOU
text: [smug] Enjoy your little losing streak.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: But on Saturday morning... real life happened.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: There's Dad. An accountant. He thinks every video game is called "the Nintendo."

speaker: NARRATOR
text: There's Mom. A very quiet librarian. [pause] She says "shh" more than any other word.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And there's Granny. She knits. She bakes. [pause] And she has never lost an argument in her life.

speaker: DAD
text: [cheerful] Family meeting! [pause] Your mother and I have noticed you spend eleven hours a day in... the Nintendo.

speaker: YOU
text: [annoyed] It's not a Nintendo, Dad. It's Cube City.

speaker: MOM
text: [calm, firm] So we made a decision. [pause] Tonight is Family Game Night.

speaker: YOU
text: [relieved] Oh. Board games. Okay, that's fine—

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [sweetly] No, dear. [pause] We're joining YOUR game.

speaker: YOU
text: [horrified] You're joining... my SERVER?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] It was the scariest sentence you had ever heard.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: That evening, the living room turned into a gaming setup. [pause] Kind of.

speaker: DAD
text: [squinting] Okay. Username. [pause] D... A... D... [pause] Where's the B?

speaker: YOU
text: [impatient] Dad, it's RIGHT there!

speaker: DAD
text: [proud] Got it! "DadBod nineteen seventy-eight."

speaker: YOU
text: [groans] Why would you tell everyone your age?!

speaker: DAD
text: [proudly] And for the password... [pause] "password."

speaker: YOU
text: [facepalm] Dad. NO.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Then Dad went to the avatar shop. [pause] And he clicked... everything.

speaker: DAD
text: [confused] Son... why am I a hot dog?

speaker: YOU
text: [deadpan] I don't know, Dad. You did that.

speaker: DAD
text: [warming up] You know what? [pause] I like it. I'm keeping it.

speaker: MOM
text: [calm] I'm not really a gamer, sweetie. [pause] I'll just watch.

speaker: YOU
text: [confused] Mom... you're completely grey.

speaker: MOM
text: [calm] Grey is classy, sweetie.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [loudly, into the phone] HELLO, PHONE. [pause] MAKE ME. A GAME. PERSON.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [confused] Which button is "go"? [pause] Oh! I bought something.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Granny pressed buttons at random... and somehow ended up looking like a billionaire.

speaker: YOU
text: [defeated] Okay. Rule number one. [pause] Do NOT talk to my friends.

speaker: DAD
text: [cheerfully] Got it, champ!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] DadBod1978 joined the server. [pause] MOM_OFFICIAL joined the server. [pause] GrannyGoodies joined the server.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The whole server saw it. [pause] Every. Single. Name.

speaker: DAD
text: [loud, typing slowly] HELLO SON. [pause] IT IS DAD. [pause] LOVE, DAD.

speaker: NOODLE
text: [laughing] Bro... is that your DAD?!

speaker: YOU
text: [whispering, panicked] Rule number one, Dad! RULE NUMBER ONE!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Then Mom found the emote button.

speaker: MOM
text: [sweetly] Mwah! [pause] Love you, honey!

speaker: DARKBLADE
text: [mocking] Ha! The legend brought his MOMMY.

speaker: DAD
text: [determined] Don't worry, son. Dad's got this. [pause] How do I jump?

speaker: YOU
text: [whisper-shouting] Spacebar!

speaker: DAD
text: [shouting at the screen] SPACE! [pause] BAR!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] He did not press the spacebar. [pause] He said it. Very loudly. To the computer.

speaker: DAD
text: [typing slowly] DEAR EVERYONE. [pause] WHERE IS THE JUMP BUTTON.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Fifty players answered at the same time. [pause] Fifty players said "SPACEBAR."

speaker: YOU
text: [whispering] Nobody look at me. [pause] I'm a tree. I'm a tree.

speaker: YOU
text: [quickly] Okay! You guys... stay here! Practice jumping! [pause] I'll be in the arena!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You ran to the Battle Arena, where nobody could embarrass you. [pause] But Mom followed you.

speaker: MOM
text: [calm] Don't mind me, sweetie. I'm just watching.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Then someone hit Mom with a sword. [pause] And Mom... hit back.

speaker: YOU
text: [stunned] Mom... how did you DO that?

speaker: MOM
text: [modest] Oh. Muscle memory.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: That's when you learned the truth. [pause] In nineteen ninety-eight, your mom was the arcade champion of the whole state.

speaker: MOM
text: [laughing softly] They called me "The Queen." [pause] I retired. For you.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Ten minutes later... she was number one on the leaderboard.

speaker: MOM
text: [sweetly] Nice try, honey! [pause] Sit up straight! [pause] Did you eat breakfast?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: She defeated a hundred players. [pause] And she made sure every single one of them was hydrated.

speaker: DARKBLADE
text: [angry] One on one, Mom! [pause] Right now!

speaker: MOM
text: [sweetly] Okay, sweetie.

speaker: MOM
text: [kind] Good game! [pause] Don't forget to stretch!

speaker: NOODLE
text: [screaming] YOUR MOM IS A LEGEND!

speaker: YOU
text: [quietly] ...I'm the legend.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Meanwhile, Granny opened a cookie stand. [pause] Just a little one.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [sweet] Fresh cookies! Two coins! [pause] Three for the cute ones!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Then a bakery. Then a factory. [pause] Then a skyscraper.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [sweetly] Cookies are now five coins. [pause] Ten coins on weekends. [pause] Fifteen if you're rude.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: She hired your friends. [pause] Then she hired your friends' friends.

speaker: NOODLE
text: [cheerful] Sorry, bro! She pays double! [pause] And there's dental!

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [sweetly] I bought your castle, dear. [pause] It was a very good deal.

speaker: YOU
text: [shocked] You BOUGHT my base?!

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [sweet, firm] You can still live there. [pause] Rent is fifty coins a week.

speaker: YOU
text: [pleading] Granny! I'm your grandson!

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [sweetly] That's why it's only fifty, dear.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] You had twelve coins.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And Dad? [pause] Dad was still trying the first jump. [pause] For almost three hours.

speaker: DAD
text: [determined] Okay. Space... bar. [pause] Space... BAR!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: But then something strange happened. [pause] The new players... started gathering around him.

speaker: DAD
text: [warm, encouraging] You can do it, kiddo! [pause] I believe in you! [pause] I don't believe in ME... but I believe in you!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: He cheered for every jump. [pause] He told terrible jokes.

speaker: DAD
text: [proud] Why did the noob cross the road? [pause] He couldn't! He was stuck in the lobby! [pause] Like me!

speaker: DAD
text: [inspiring] Listen up, kids! [pause] Falling is not failing! [pause] Failing is when you stop trying! [pause] I fell two hundred times today!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: By sunset... the whole server was calling him "Dad."

speaker: KID
text: [shy] Mister Hot Dog? [pause] Can you be my dad too?

speaker: DAD
text: [touched] Of course, kiddo. [pause] Everybody gets a dad today!

speaker: NOODLE
text: [happy] Your dad is so cool, bro. [pause] My dad never plays with me.

speaker: YOU
text: [quietly, jealous] ...He's MY dad.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Your mom was the best fighter. Your granny was the richest player. [pause] Your dad was everyone's favorite.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [quietly] And you... were just "the son."

speaker: YOU
text: [angry] This is MY game! My friends! My server! [pause] You're taking EVERYTHING!

speaker: MOM
text: [surprised, soft] Sweetie...

speaker: YOU
text: [shouting] I wish you never joined!

speaker: MOM
text: [quietly] Maybe we pushed too hard.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [softly] Go talk to him, dear. [pause] Not you. [pause] Him.

speaker: DAD
text: [softly] Hey, champ. [pause] Can I tell you something?

speaker: DAD
text: [softly] I don't care about the game. [pause] I don't know how to jump. I don't even know what a "noob" is.

speaker: DAD
text: [softly, sincere] You've been in that world for a whole year... [pause] and I just wanted to see it. With you.

speaker: YOU
text: [quietly] ...You could've just asked.

speaker: DAD
text: [small laugh] I did. [pause] You said, "Not now, Dad." [pause] About two hundred times.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And then... at eleven p.m.... the alarm went off.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [booming, alarm] Warning! The Block King has awakened! [pause] If the server falls... everything resets!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The Block King. The biggest boss in Cube City history.

speaker: BOSS
text: [booming, echoing] CUBE CITY... [pause] IS MINE!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: He smashed the arena. He smashed Tycoon Valley. [pause] He smashed Granny's cookie factory.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [outraged] MY COOKIES!

speaker: DARKBLADE
text: [panicked] Clan, attack! [pause] Clan? CLAN?!

speaker: NOODLE
text: [panicked] Bro, where ARE you?! We need you!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The server health bar was dropping. [pause] Ninety percent. Fifty. [pause] Twenty.

speaker: YOU
text: [determined] Dad... [pause] I can't win this alone.

speaker: DAD
text: [warm] Then don't.

speaker: YOU
text: [urgent] Mom! Grandma! The server needs us!

speaker: MOM
text: [stern] It's eleven p.m., young man. [pause] Bedtime.

speaker: MOM
text: [cold, focused] ...Five minutes. [pause] Let's go.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [cracking knuckles] Granny's coming, dear.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [epic] And for the first time ever... your whole family logged in. Together.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] Party formed. [pause] Party name: "The Family."

speaker: YOU
text: [commanding] Okay! Mom, you're the tank. [pause] Granny, we need gear!

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [proud] Swords for everyone! [pause] Put it on my tab!

speaker: MOM
text: [battle cry] Kids! Formation! [pause] And wear your helmets!

speaker: MOM
text: [fierce] Mommy's got you! [pause] Everybody behind me!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Mom blocked the punches. You led the attack. [pause] Even DarkBlade joined your team.

speaker: DARKBLADE
text: [grudging] Just this once.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [shouting] Healing potions! A hundred of them! [pause] Family discount!

speaker: YOU
text: [commanding] Noodle, left side! DarkBlade, right side! [pause] Everybody, ATTACK!

speaker: BOSS
text: [booming, laughing] FOOLS! [pause] My shield cannot break!

speaker: NOODLE
text: [urgent] The crystal! On top of the obby tower! [pause] Someone has to jump up there and break it!

speaker: YOU
text: [panicked] I can't! If I leave, the whole team falls apart!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Everybody was fighting. [pause] Everybody... except one.

speaker: DAD
text: [quietly, determined] Son. [pause] I've been practicing.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Dad. The man who couldn't jump. [pause] Versus one hundred floors of obby.

speaker: DAD
text: [nervous] Space... bar.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: He jumped. [pause] He jumped again. [pause] He slipped... and didn't fall.

speaker: NOODLE
text: [chanting] Jump, Dad! [pause] Jump, Dad!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And then the whole server started chanting.

speaker: DARKBLADE
text: [shouting] Jump, Mister Hot Dog! JUMP!

speaker: DAD
text: [panicking] No no no no no... [pause] Okay. Okay! I'm okay!

speaker: YOU
text: [shouting] JUMP, DAD, JUMP!

speaker: DAD
text: [whispering] For my son.

speaker: BOSS
text: [booming, shocked] NO! [pause] Defeated... by a HOT DOG?!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [booming, triumphant] VICTORY! [pause] Server saved!

speaker: MOM
text: [proud, shouting] That's my husband! [pause] THAT'S MY HUSBAND!

speaker: DAD
text: [laughing, emotional] I did a jump! [pause] Son, I did a JUMP!

speaker: YOU
text: [laughing] You did a HUNDRED jumps, Dad!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] Most valuable player: DadBod1978.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: That night, nobody went to bed at eleven. [pause] Not even Mom.

speaker: MOM
text: [sleepy] Five more minutes...

speaker: DAD
text: [sleepy, smiling] Same time next week, champ?

speaker: YOU
text: [softly] Same time, Dad. [pause] Every week.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And the next Saturday... YOU called the family meeting.

speaker: YOU
text: [cheerful] Family Game Night! [pause] Same server! Same time!

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [sweetly] And don't forget your rent, dear.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Dad still can't do a double jump. [pause] Mom started a training class. [pause] DarkBlade signed up first.

speaker: DARKBLADE
text: [shy] Thank you, Mrs. Mom.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And Granny bought the Block King's castle. [pause] It's a cookie museum now. [pause] Tickets are ten coins.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] DarkBlade's mom joined the server.

speaker: DARKBLADE
text: [horrified] ...MOM?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warmly] So... if YOUR parents joined your server, who would be the noob? [pause] Tell me in the comments!
